§aThings get dangerous from here.§f

White phosphorus is rarer than its red cousin. It drops about 10% of the time from Nether phosphorus ore, or you can centrifuge the ore and phosphorus crystals for more. Crystals give the best yield at 2 WP per batch.

The main use is WP ammunition, which applies Phosphorus Burns. Unlike regular fire, water only temporarily slows the damage. Nasty stuff.

§cWARNING:§f Holding white phosphorus hurts you. It's not pyrophoric like the red variant, so it won't ignite your inventory, but direct contact damages you on contact. Wear gloves. Or better yet, don't hold it.
